info.name: UCA-CFC Connect Completo
info.description: Colecci?n completa: conserva las pruebas base de autenticaci?n, roles, errores, b?squedas y logout, y a?ade smoke tests de lectura para todos los m?dulos REST sin mutar datos.

exec:
pm.test('Sin token responde 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Error de seguridad es JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
// Explicitly strip any Authorization header that may have been injected
// by a folder-level pre-request script or collection-level auth.
pm.test('ADMIN puede consultar usuarios', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
// Pre-request: ensure clienteAccessToken is populated before "Cliente intenta consultar usuarios"
// This runs before the CLIENTE login request itself, so nothing to do here.
// The login response test script stores clienteAccessToken.
pm.test('CLIENTE no puede consultar usuarios', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
// Ensure the clienteAccessToken is set before this request runs.
// The preceding "Cliente no puede consultar usuarios" request stores it,
// but if this request runs in isolation we need to fetch it here.
if (err) { console.error('Cliente login failed:', err); return; }
console.error('Cliente login: no accessToken in response', body);
// Ensures adminAccessToken is fresh so "Administrador consulta usuarios" works
// when this folder is run independently.
// Skips the login if a valid (non-empty) accessToken already exists.
if (err) { console.error('Admin login failed:', err); return; }
console.error('Admin login: no accessToken in response', body);
pm.test('Busqueda de cursos responde 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Filtro de clientes responde 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
// Ensures accessToken is available when this folder runs independently.
if (err) { console.error('Admin login failed:', err); return; }
console.error('Admin login: no accessToken in response', body);
